blocks.text: 3.1 To use the App you must be at least [18] years old, hold an active Account with the Bank, and have a compatible Device with a mobile number registered with the Bank.

3.2 Registration requires verification of your identity using your Account details, registered mobile number, OTP and any other method the Bank requires, including electronic Know-Your-Customer (eKYC) checks.
3.3 The App is bound to one registered Device at a time. Registering a new Device will deactivate the App on the previous Device. You must re-register if you change your mobile number or Device.
3.4 The Bank may refuse or cancel any registration at its sole discretion, including where information provided is incomplete, inaccurate, or fails verification.
3.5 Joint accounts may be accessed through the App only in accordance with the operating mandate on file. Transactions requiring more than one signatory may be restricted to view-only access.
4.1 The App may allow you to:

items: View account balances, transaction history and e-statements
Transfer funds between your own Accounts, to third parties within the Bank, and to other banks and e-wallets through InstaPay and PESONet
Pay bills, load mobile credit and pay registered merchants, including by QR code
Manage cards (activate, lock, unlock, set limits) and request cheque books
Open time deposits and apply for other products offered in the App
Receive notifications, alerts and secure messages

5.1 You must keep your Credentials and Device secure at all times. In particular, you must:

items: Never disclose your password, MPIN or OTP to anyone, including persons claiming to be Bank staff. The Bank will never ask for your OTP, password or MPIN by phone, SMS, email or social media.
Choose a password and MPIN that are not easy to guess, and change them regularly
Not write down or store Credentials in an unprotected form
Lock your Device with a passcode or biometric, and not leave it unattended while logged in
Download the App only from the official Apple App Store, Google Play Store or other store named by the Bank
Not use the App on a rooted, jailbroken or otherwise compromised Device
Keep your Device operating system and the App updated to the latest version
